hook: Finish every video with one clear next step.
caption:
Finish every video with one clear next step.

If you ask for three things, people do none of them.

Most creators publish one long episode and then move on to the next one.

Try this on your next episode and compare.

https://incubrix.com/?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=creator_engine_q4_2026&utm_content=EORC57-C03&utm_term=workflow

points: If you ask for three things, people do none of them.
Most creators publish one long episode and then move on to the next one.
Start by listening for claims, not topics.
Claims make people stop scrolling because they create tension.
Scan the recording in five minute windows.
